skill.description: Open a local visual schema studio to design, validate, save, and export database models for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MSSQL.
skill.summary: Design local database models visually, then export SQL for downstream implementation.

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from Markdown code spans, loopback URLs, local model filenames, and safety guidance. Confirmed risks remain: the skill can start a local DB Craft service through PowerShell and Node, and AI generation can use OPENAI_API_KEY. I found no prompt injection language or evidence of intentional data exfiltration.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before starting the launcher, and verify the DB Craft app directory before running server.js.
Read OPENAI_API_KEY only when the user requests AI generation, and never log or display key values.
Keep the default bind host on 127.0.0.1 and refuse non-loopback hosts unless the user explicitly configures them.

remediation.issue: Workspace handoff artifacts may contain project details
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before writing handoff files and recommend repository ignore rules when artifacts contain private requirements.

content.user_title: Design Database Schemas With DB Craft
content.value_statement: Database schema design can become fragmented across notes, SQL drafts, and diagrams. DB Craft opens a local visual studio to model tables, validate structure, and export SQL.
actual_capabilities: Opens the local DB Craft visual schema studio in a browser.
Creates and edits models for MySQL 8, PostgreSQL 14, SQLite, and MSSQL.
Imports existing CREATE TABLE scripts into the visual model.
Generates table designs with a configured AI provider or Codex handoff.
Saves DB Craft model files and exports SQL into the active workspace.
Guides validation, auto-layout, and handoff to migration workflows.
limitations: The current public package supports Windows with local Node.js and PowerShell.
It does not execute schema changes against live databases by default.
AI table generation may send prompts to the configured model provider.
Browser directory permissions may require a manual user selection.

use_cases.title: Plan New Service Tables
use_cases.description: Create a visual model for a new service, validate table structure, and export SQL for implementation review.

use_cases.title: Convert Requirements Into Models
use_cases.description: Turn product requirements or screenshots into tables that align frontend data needs with backend storage.

use_cases.title: Review Schema Handoffs
use_cases.description: Inspect relationships, generated tables, and exported SQL before a separate migration workflow applies changes.

prompt_templates.title: Open A New Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Open DB Craft and create a MySQL 8 model for a student management system. Add student, class, and teacher tables.

prompt_templates.title: Import Existing SQL
prompt_templates.prompt: Open DB Craft and import my existing table definitions into the current workspace model. Validate the structure and organize the diagram.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Tables With AI
prompt_templates.prompt: Use DB Craft AI to design tables for an e-commerce cart, order, and payment workflow. Save the model in the active workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Migration Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Continue from the current DB Craft handoff, update the model with the requested changes, validate it, export SQL, and summarize deployment notes.

output_examples.output: DB Craft opens the local studio, creates a booking model, adds core tables, validates the structure, and prepares exportable SQL.
The skill imports the definitions into the current model, arranges the diagram, flags structure issues, and keeps the workspace model updated.

output_examples.input: Prepare this schema for migration review.
output_examples.output: DB Craft saves the visual model, exports SQL, and creates a clear handoff for a separate migration or deployment workflow.

best_practices: Keep each project model saved in the active workspace directory.
Review generated SQL before using it in a real database workflow.
Use personal API keys carefully and hide secrets from screenshots.
anti_patterns: Treating DB Craft output as an automatic production database change.
Starting duplicate local services before checking the existing service.
Placing secrets in schema comments, AI prompts, or public screenshots.

faq.question: What is DB Craft?
faq.answer: DB Craft is a local visual studio for designing database schemas and exporting SQL.

faq.question: Which databases are supported?
faq.answer: It supports MySQL 8, PostgreSQL 14, SQLite, and MSSQL model workflows.

faq.question: Does it change a live database?
faq.answer: No. The public skill stops at model, SQL export, and handoff by default.

faq.question: Is DB Craft a cloud service?
faq.answer: No. It opens a local app and writes model artifacts into the active workspace.

faq.question: Can AI generation send data outside my machine?
faq.answer: Yes. AI Build may send prompts to the model provider configured by the user.

faq.question: What local requirements are needed?
faq.answer: The current package needs Windows, Node.js, PowerShell, a browser, and the local DB Craft app files.
